column1: # b09: ovl_ending (src/ovl_ending/E22690.c; E25C80.c is data only): the ending, the same sprite-script engine as ovl_intro plus a scrolling backdrop.
# Core_RunEndingLoop DMAs it to 0x8020C0D0 and calls the entry; Gfx_BuildFrameDisplayList calls func_8020C15C every frame in state 5.
# Sprite slots D_8022BB38[150] use the same flag bits as ovl_intro (see b09_intro.tsv).

column3: overlay entry (Core_RunEndingLoop calls 0x8020C0D0 after func_80036220 loads it): Ending_ClearAllSprites, view rect D_8022BB10..1C = (10, 1, 300, 223), zeroes the script position and timers

called each frame by Gfx_BuildFrameDisplayList in state 5: runs Ending_RunSpriteScript into one of its two display lists D_8022EA18 and calls it from the frame's list; returns the script result (0 = finished, core then goes to state 7)

same engine as Intro_RunSpriteScript: spawns scene D_8020F690's entries from D_802107F0 when their delay runs out, draws both passes (Ending_UpdateAndDrawSprites), from frame 0xF78 also Ending_UpdateAndDrawScrollingBackdrop(1, 0x4C2), advances the animations (D_8020F880); returns 0 after the last scene, else 1
searches every scene's entries in D_802107F0 for the one whose slot (unk22) is the sprite; returns the entry index and stores the scene index, or -1
fills sprite slot n: flags, position, size, texture offset, width (rounded up to 16 for CI4), image/palette, duration, sort key; clears the effect state, alpha 0xFF
resets all 150 sprite slots of D_8022BB38 (flags 0, alpha 0xFF)
resets one sprite slot; Ending_RunSpriteScript calls it when the sprite's last animation step ends
counts the slots without the active bit 0x80000000 (not called)
counts the slots with the active bit 0x80000000; the scene advances when it is 0
index of the first slot without the active bit, or -1
flag 0x20000000: grows the drawn width (0x100 set) or height from 0 to the full size over the step's frames, anchored at the far edge set by Ending_SetClipAnchor; returns 0xFF when done
flag 0x40000000: shrinks the drawn width (0x400 set) or height from the full size to 0 over the step's frames; returns 0xFF when done
stores the sprite's right/bottom edge (x+w, y+h) for the clip grow/shrink; called when a step has 0x60000000
steps unk4E between 0 and 255 over the step's frames (arg 0 up, 1 down); Ending_UpdateAndDrawSprites uses it as the env alpha for flags 0x10/0x20; returns 0xFF when done
same code as Ending_StepAlphaFade, called for flags 0x40/0x80, whose value Ending_UpdateAndDrawSprites uses as the env colour (r=g=b) instead of alpha
flag 0x800: moves the sprite position towards the target (unk2A, unk2C) by |target-start|/frames per frame, snaps to it at the end; returns 0xFF when done
stores the move target and the current position as the move start
flag 0x4000: the x-only version of Ending_StepMoveXY
flag 0x8000: the y-only version of Ending_StepMoveXY
flags 0x1000/0x10000000: counts unk34 up and returns 0xFF when it reaches the step's frames
zeroes the wait counter unk34; called when a step with 0x1000 starts

bubble-sorts the slots by key unk3C, then for the active sprites of the pass (arg 1: flag 0x800000 set, 0: clear) steps their move/clip/fade/wait effects and clears each finished effect's flag, clips the rect to the view rect and emits the texture load and texrect (flipped when 0x20000/0x40000) (r2: was Ending_UpdateAndDrawSprites; it also steps the effects)

arg0 0 resets; else draws picture arg0 of D_80210800 (CI8, 304x222 in 6-line strips) wrapped horizontally at a scroll offset that it moves by width/arg1 px per frame, fades it in, cross-fades to picture arg0+1 at frame 0x26AC, starts Audio_StartSeqFadeOut(0x1E0) at frame D_8022BAF8 and stops after the second fades out (r2: was Ending_UpdateAndDrawScrollingBackdrop; it also advances its scroll/fade)
